daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

The Constitutional Court (MK) has ruled that the MBG program budget must be separated from the education budget, while maintaining that the 20% education allocation in the state budget must not be reduced. The decision has prompted calls from legislators for the government and DPR to find solutions to ensure the school meal program continues, with some parliamentary leaders requesting that MBG evaluations use valid nutritional indicators and others suggesting efficiency measures. President Prabowo's administration has indicated it will study the MK ruling before responding.

  • President Prabowo has asked officials not to mobilize crowds for his regional visits.
  • The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) detained four suspects in a PT Jasindo corruption case related to commission payments.
  • The Attorney General's Office has revealed seven companies allegedly using the legal services of Don Ritto in its ongoing investigation.
  • The AGO will transfer Ferry Boboho to the Witness and Victim Protection Agency (LPSK) for safety reasons.
  • The KPK reported that regional head arrests have increased in 2026 and that auctions of seized corruption assets have reached Rp 59 million.
  • President Prabowo has not yet decided on a replacement for Bank Indonesia Governor Perry Warjiyo.
  • The father of a KPK employee has been implicated as a case broker who demanded Rp 2 billion from the Pemalang regent to handle a legal matter.

Foreign Policy & Defence

Indonesia is exploring cooperation with the United States on food security and artificial intelligence. The bilateral engagement reflects Indonesia's efforts to deepen ties with Washington on strategic sectors. Additionally, Indonesia and Morocco are optimistic about achieving positive momentum following the establishment of a strategic partnership between the two countries.

  • Indonesia and Albania are aiming to implement a migrant worker agreement by year-end.
  • Indonesia has condemned all violence occurring in the West Bank.
  • Japan has praised Indonesia's role in ASEAN and Asian leadership, with the Indonesian ambassador noting that trust is the greatest achievement in Japan-ASEAN relations.
  • President Prabowo has raised performance allowances for the TNI, with four-star generals now receiving Rp 48 million.

Other

President Prabowo has led the signing of 62,000 subsidized home mortgages under the FLPP (Fasilitas Likuiditas Pembiayaan Perumahan) scheme for low-income households, marking a major push in the government's affordable housing initiative. The government is also targeting major progress on waste management by the end of 2027, with Prabowo issuing an ultimatum that all waste problems must be resolved by that deadline.

  • The Ministry of Industry is pushing for greener industrial estates across Indonesia as part of environmental sustainability efforts.
  • Indonesia has detected 5,019 wildfire hotspots amid El Niño threats, with BMKG predicting the phenomenon will peak in December or January 2027.
  • The government seeks to integrate dairy cooperatives into the MBG supply chain to support the school meal program.
  • The Agriculture Minister is preparing free superior seeds for 870,000 hectares of national plantations.
  • A foreign airline pilot was arrested at Soekarno-Hatta Airport for allegedly smuggling 70,114 ecstasy pills (26 kg).
